19.translation: He argues that the birth and death, which he has said are not always present, are also of the bodies and not of the self. This means that beings are bodies that move and disappear, whether they are created or not. Just as the earthly objects on the earth are like pots and other objects. When these beings are transformed by birth and death, this indirectly perceived universe does not reverse itself, nor does it reverse itself. This means that there is only one form. When the earth is sold, so is the earth. When this is considered, there is no room for grief.
